sn47.37:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.37:1.3: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.37:1.4: As he dwells thus contemplating the body in the body, whatever desire he has for the body is abandoned.
sn47.37:1.5: With the abandoning of desire, the Deathless is realized.
sn47.37:4.1: phenomena in phenomena … having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.37:4.2: As he dwells thus contemplating phenomena in phenomena, whatever desire he has for phenomena is abandoned.
sn47.37:4.3: With the abandoning of desire, the Deathless is realized.”
